name: Medina VR | Meet the Sahaba
summary:
# Experience the golden age of Islam in Virtual Reality!
Immerse yourself in the vibrant historical Medina and join Osman, Zubeyr and other characters on an unforgettable journey. **Get to know the Sahaba** – the companions of the Prophet (pbuh)– and learn about their way of life, their values and their daily routines.
